name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Lifecycle Marketing & Marketing Automation | HubSpot Workflows, Email Nurture, Segmentation
summary: Lifecycle marketing and marketing operations specialist with 5+ years building CRM and marketing-automation systems in HubSpot and GoHighLevel, on top of a decade in client-facing SaaS and agency roles. Builds and deploys nurture journeys end to end: segmentation, workflows, landing pages, forms, email sequences, and the reporting that shows what's working. Architected a 20+ workflow lifecycle system covering lead capture, qualification, booking, onboarding, nurture, and reactivation, and keeps databases clean enough to trust. Lead-generation focused, with A/B testing and conversion optimization built into every program.

Build and deploy segmented email nurture sequences, landing pages, and lead forms in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, adapting a shared template base to each client's brand.
Manage contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and lead scoring, with strict data-hygiene protocols and validated imports into HubSpot, Salesforce, and GoHighLevel.
Built segmented outreach campaigns (website visibility, missed calls, low reviews) and an audit workflow that enrolled 180+ contacts.
Track campaign performance with GA4, UTM conventions, and dashboards for funnel progression and ROI, and turn the results into optimization recommendations.
Maintain marketing-to-CRM syncs and integrations in Zapier, Make, and n8n, including webhooks and API calls.
